map.肺炎(CURB-65)严重度评估器，依据意识模糊、尿素氮、呼吸频率、血压、年龄5: Pneumonia (CURB-65) Severity Assessor uses confusion, urea, respiratory rate, blood pressure and age to grade CAP severity and care setting. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.CURB-65 肺炎严重度评分 = 意识障碍 + 尿素氮 大于7mmol/L +: CURB-65 score = confusion + urea >7 mmol/L + respiratory rate >=30/min + blood pressure (systolic <90 or diastolic <=60 mmHg) + age >=65 years, 1 point each, max 5; 0-1 low risk (outpatient), 2 moderate (admit), 3-5 high risk (admit), with ICU/HDU considered especially at 4-5. 30-day mortality (Lim 2003): score 0 0.7%, 1 2.1%, 2 9.2%, 3 14.5%, 4 40%, 5 uncertain.
map.0–4 分死亡率取自 Lim WS et al. Thorax 2003;58:: Mortality for scores 0–4 comes from the derivation cohort in Lim et al. Thorax 2003, table 4. For score 5, table 4 reports 1/7 (14%) while the abstract reports 57%; the numbers conflict and the sample is small, so no definite estimate is provided. Population data do not directly predict individual risk. ICU/HDU referral is considered especially at scores 4–5; clinical assessment determines the final decision.
map.意识+尿素+年龄≥65 三项阳性→3 分，30 天死亡率约 14.5%（Lim: Confusion + urea + age >=65 positive -> 3 points, 30-day mortality about 14.5% (Lim 2003); hospital assessment advised. ICU/HDU referral is considered especially at scores 4-5, with the final decision left to clinical judgment.
map.0 分 30 天死亡率约 0.7%、1 分约 2.1%（Lim 2003），可门: Score 0 has about 0.7% 30-day mortality and score 1 about 2.1% (Lim 2003); outpatient antibiotics and follow-up are appropriate.
map.2 分中危(约 9.2%)，住院治疗、静脉抗生素。: Score 2 is moderate risk (about 9.2%); admit and give IV antibiotics.
